    AI Overview
    Yes, most banks are open on Patriots' Day (the third Monday in April) because it is not a federal holiday, meaning the Federal Reserve operates normally. While Massachusetts and Maine observe it as a state holiday—closing state offices and schools—financial institutions typically remain open. However, some local branches may choose to close. 
    Key Details for Patriots' Day (April 20, 2026): 
    • Banks: Most open; some local branches may close.
    • Stock Market: NYSE and Dow Jones are open.
    • Federal Offices & Post Offices: Open.
    • State/Municipal Offices & Courts: Closed in MA and ME.
    • Retail/Restaurants: Generally open. 
    It is always recommended to check with your specific local branch for their hours, particularly in Massachusetts and Maine.
